description: Highway Mileage: Beginning 2008 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. The Highway Mileage Report is an annual publication that lists the mileage of roadway and maintenance jurisdiction/ownership of roadways within each municipality of New York State. Information is current as of the publication date. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are mileage, highway, jurisdiction, road. The table has 10 columns. Attribution on the portal: New York State Department of Transportation. The portal shows 2022-10-11 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
